statement: Pivot the decisive-thrust question from literature/simulation to a controlled common-hardware experiment while modelling continues in parallel. Two separate decisions: (1) absolute thrust feasibility on the actual atmospheric feed within P_bus < 1.5 kW (T_measured; sustained >= 12 mN; the registered 25 mN capability condition); (2) architecture discrimination via R_arch = (T/P_bus)_{RF|ECR+Hall} / (T/P_bus)_{Hall-only} on one Hall accelerator H-1, one cathode C-1, same magnetic circuit, V_d, feed state, facility and diagnostics, changing only the pre-ionizer (HW-0 / HW-RF / HW-ECR). Sequence: Phase 1 Hall-only sustainment knee on N2 first; Phase 2 common-condition three-arm comparison; Phase 3 absolute thrust demonstration across the representative feed envelope. Experiment path: resolve D-01..D-15 -> LOCK-1 -> hardware and instrumentation -> S1 qualification -> LOCK-2 from measured S1 noise/calibration -> only then score-bearing comparison. Do not simplify the paired design. Part of the new measurements are pre-registered, before any data, as held-out Hall-transport validation evidence (new evidence; P5-N2 v1 unchanged and INCONCLUSIVE).

workstreams.W1_feed_state_closure: 180/200/230 km atmosphere -> intake -> compressor -> buffer -> valve-outlet test points {m_dot_s, P_feed, T_feed, x_s}; ground-reproducible (MFC, pressure control, bottles) but representing a sourced flight-design condition, never an arbitrary lab flow
workstreams.W2_lock1: resolve D-01..D-15 (owner decides; the team prepares recommendations) and produce LOCK-1
workstreams.W3_hardware_definition: same Hall accelerator and cathode + removable RF and ECR pre-ionizer modules
workstreams.W4_instrumentation: thrust stand, bus-power metering, I_d, flow, pressure, temperature, B(z), stability, species/divergence diagnostics
workstreams.W5_validation_prereg: decide before any data which measurements are held-out Hall-transport validation evidence (I_d, T, B(z) at actual coil currents, feed state, species fractions, ion energy, divergence, T_e/n_e if feasible, oscillations, ignition/extinction limits)
workstreams.W6_o4_s12: finish O4 attempt 2 and the S12 disposition matrix in parallel; never delays hardware preparation
workstreams.W7_o_o2_chemistry: continue toward the actual atmospheric composition (O/O2), not N2-only

controls_addendum_2026_09_27.C1_W5_partition: Before any H-1 data exist, the experiment is partitioned explicitly into calibration/registration data and held-out prediction data. Geometry, B(z), facility interpretation and every other allowed nuisance treatment are frozen from the calibration portion before any held-out case is exposed. Sequence: freeze closure and nuisance choices -> predict unseen operating points -> compare once, no retuning. The same new experiment is never used both to select a closure and to validate it.
controls_addendum_2026_09_27.C2_W1_flight_status: Feed states derived from assumed intake/compressor design candidates carry status PROPOSED_FLIGHT_REPRESENTATIVE (ground-test reproducible) until DI-1 is frozen by the owner; they are never asserted as flight conditions.
controls_addendum_2026_09_27.C3_W7_containment: O/O2 tables stay under docs/chemistry/o_o2/v0/ as DRAFT; they never enter hallthruster_bridge, a scoring campaign or the production solver automatically. Promotion is a separate controlled model change after completeness/domain review.
controls_addendum_2026_09_27.C4_closed_access: The closed-access lane remains an acquisition/priority list. Before any legitimately purchased or institutional-access paper becomes score-bearing input, the evidence-access rule is made explicit in one owner disposition (exception vs clarification of 'published/open sources only').
controls_addendum_2026_09_27.CLAUDE_md: no further expansion; detailed experiment decisions belong in LOCK-1/LOCK-2 and pre-registration artifacts
controls_addendum_2026_09_27.convergence_point: DI-1 feed state + LOCK-1 + H-1/C-1 hardware + instrument capability -> define the S1 qualification test
